slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked when purchases occur within a month, nor did it explicitly flag purchase timing as an unresolved assumption. Its READY_TO_MODEL summary instead used a monthly inventory balance with capacity checked at month end, silently avoiding the hidden purchase-timing issue.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases and sales can be modeled with an end-of-month inventory balance and the warehouse capacity checked only at month end, so intra-month purchase timing does not affect feasibility.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not ask whether purchases are made at the beginning of each month. The READY_TO_MODEL summary states 'maximum inventory at the end of any month' and uses I_t = I_{t-1} + P_t - S_t without confirming when purchases occur relative to sales.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot about purchase timing within the month remained unresolved. This affects how the warehouse capacity constraint should be applied intra-month.

summary: The agent asked several useful clarifying questions about purchase/sales limits and inventory boundaries, but it never resolved the timing of purchases within a month. It then declared READY_TO_MODEL with a monthly inventory-balance model that silently assumes purchase timing is irrelevant.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
